twoFactor.offHint: If someone finds out your password, they cannot get in without the code that only shows on your phone. Recommended for administrators.
twoFactor.passwordStep: To start, confirm it is you by typing your password.
twoFactor.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy or similar).
twoFactor.step2: In the app choose “add account” and scan this QR code.
twoFactor.step3: Type the 6-digit code the app shows:
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code to link the authenticator app
twoFactor.manual: Cannot scan it? Type this key into the app:
twoFactor.wrongCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Use the one showing in the app right now.
twoFactor.error: Could not complete it. Try again.
twoFactor.backupDesc: Each one works once to sign in if you lose your phone. We will not show them again.
twoFactor.disableStep: To turn it off, type your password and a code from the app (or a backup code).
